CtxAnswerLedger.description:
The ctx-answer ledger (LLP 0051 D1): the ordered answers the deterministic
ctx surface gave during one invocation. Record mode produces it; replay
mode consumes it. Reads are never ledgered — `ctx.db` reads always
re-evaluate against the executing tier's current view; the ledger pins
*answers* only. This is LLP 0043 M2's captured replay environment as a
defined channel: LLP 0008 pins the client wire to exactly
`{generatedIds, now}`; the auth fingerprint is server-retained and never
crosses the client wire.

auth_fingerprint.description:
Fingerprint of the resolved auth context the handler observed
(LLP 0043 §Auth posture). Checked at replay when present: a mismatch
surfaces `SNAPBACK_AUTH_STALE_RESULT` rather than replaying under new
authority. Server-retained (D1 wire split) — record-mode outputs leave
it unset on client-bound surfaces.

ids.description:
Every host-generated id, in answer order (LLP 0008's `generatedIds`):
`ctx.runtime.id()` answers and `ctx.db.insert` row-id generation share
one ordered sequence.

now.description: The frozen invocation clock every `ctx.runtime.now()` answered with.

version.description:
Ledger format version, versioned alongside the shared data-tier
profile (LLP 0051 D5) so pre-extension ledgers stay replayable.

DryRunRead.description:
One captured read dependency, projected to the camelCase wire (LLP 0032
P8 casing rule).

DryRunWrite.description: One discarded write with the row value it would have produced.

row.description: The row after the write (absent for deletes).

DryRunWriteSummary.description: One predicted write, summarized (no row values).

description:
The `function.explain` / `mutationDryRun` wire report (LLP 0024 §Dry-Run,
LLP 0051 D8 / Increment 4). Rides `HostOpsResult.data.dryRun`; the
committed schema is `schemas/dry-run.report.schema.json` (DK-7). This is
the shape the Exact-side Acto dry-run operation (LLP 0329 E-D) consumes.

Mutations cannot touch secrets by construction (secret access is
action-only), so the report is presentable to agents without a redaction
pass. `ok: true` on the envelope means the dry-run RAN and this report is
authoritative evidence — a `wouldCommit: false` report is still a
successful explanation.

denied.description: True when a permission-class pre-execution gate rejected the mutation.

deterministicInputs.description:
The recorded ctx-answer ledger (LLP 0051 D1) — literally the
deterministic answers this execution consumed.

diagnostics.description:
Report-scoped diagnostics: the would-be commit failure when
`wouldCommit` is false, plus advisory notes.

predictedWrites.description: Table/id/op/field summaries of the discarded writes — safe to expose.

sideEffects.description:
Always empty for queries/mutations (LLP 0024); future actions need a
separate contract.

snapshotVersion.description: The database version the dry-run evaluated against.

wouldCommit.description: Whether the identical commit path would have committed.

writeSet.description: The discarded writes, row-granular with resulting values.

title: DryRunReport
